summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against all nine paragraphs of S.5.iii and all five paragraphs of S.5.iv. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the additional-service claim, comparative glory, fasting conditions, food-cost gift, recipient prayer, asking promise, categorical prohibition on questioning, and Hermas’s stated necessity to ask his companion. The simplified edition retains these claims despite sentence restructuring. Notes distinguish editorial supplements and partially preserved readings from preserved text, retain the selected working readings, and accurately disclose the supplied bounded comparison reports. Reader-facing “servant” follows current policy. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied working source and disclosure evidence; it does not authenticate unseen images, certify editions, establish exhaustive collation, or claim a uniquely correct interpretation.
